description: This file defines the NoopHealthCheckServer class, a no-operation implementation of the HealthCheckServer interface. It provides empty implementations for registering health check resources and starting/stopping the server, with the start method logging a warning message.

classes.name: NoopHealthCheckServer
classes.description: A no-op implementation for the health check server, providing empty start and stop methods and a warning log during startup.

methods.name: registerHealthCheckResources
methods.description: Empty implementation for registering health check resources.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Logs a warning message and returns a succeeded Future indicating the server is 'started'.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Returns a succeeded Future indicating the server has stopped.
